subject: Renewal + pool top-up: co-term request & billing schedule options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@quantumhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + pool top-up: co-term request & billing schedule options

Hi Asha,

Hope you had a good weekend. Quantum Health's Dedicated pool renewal is coming up on 2027-03-15 and I wanted to propose bundling the capacity top-up you mentioned into the renewal so we can co-term the contracts and avoid two separate PO cycles. Summary of our proposal: 

- Add 12 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs to your existing pool (bringing you to a 48-GPU reserved pool)
- Throughput target: sustained 3K tokens/sec aggregate, with optional burst headroom up to 6K tokens/sec
- Pricing: blended rate on the additional GPUs for the remainder of the 12-month term (details in attached addendum)
- Billing options: monthly invoicing (standard), or split invoicing with an up-front PR-portion + monthly consumption invoices (see options below)

If we bundle this into the renewal we can co-term to 2028-03-15 and issue a single PO amendment instead of a separate order. I attached the addendum that outlines the adjusted SLA and a PO amendment template you can drop into your procurement system.

If this sounds right I can generate a redlined amendment and a DocuSign envelope for signatures. Quick ask: which billing cadence does procurement prefer — (A) single monthly invoice, (B) 50% up-front + monthly remaining 50%, or (C) net-30 consolidated monthly?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0167

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-addendum-2027.pdf (PDF), QH_PO_Template_Amendment_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@quantumhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 14:23:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + pool top-up: co-term request & billing schedule options

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. We like the idea of co-terming, reduces headaches for Procurement. A few clarifying questions before I take it to Purchasing: 

1) Can you confirm the billing impact in dollars for the 12 added GPUs on a monthly amortized basis and what the up-front payment would be under option B?
2) Our security team will want confirmation that the KV cache and telemetry retention remain unchanged under the addendum (no additional data egress).
3) We need a PO-ready line-item breakdown for our ERP import (CSV or XLSX).

If you can send a line-item spreadsheet and a sample PO amendment, I can get Purchasing to do a quick review this week.

—Asha
Asha Raman
Sr. Procurement Manager, Quantum Health
asha.raman@quantumhealth.com | +1 617-555-2480
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@quantumhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + pool top-up: co-term request & billing schedule options

Hi Asha — thanks, questions answered inline below and attached the CSV you can drop into ERP.

On Mon, Feb 8, 2027 at 2:23 PM Asha Raman <asha.raman@quantumhealth.com> wrote:
> 1) Can you confirm the billing impact in dollars for the 12 added GPUs on a monthly amortized basis and what the up-front payment would be under option B?

Yes — see "throughput-sla-summary-quantumhealth.xlsx" attached. Quick figures: amortized additional monthly charge = $28,500; Option B up-front (50%) = $171,000 at signature (applies to the remaining term after co-term alignment). I also included a line-item CSV for ERP import: "QH_PO_Lineitems_v1.csv" (embedded in the XLSX tab).

> 2) Our security team will want confirmation that the KV cache and telemetry retention remain unchanged under the addendum (no additional data egress).

Confirmed. The addendum does not change retention, export, or telemetry policies — this is purely a capacity and SLA change. I flagged this in section 2.3 of the attached addendum. If they want an official attestation we can provide an emailed confirmation from our security team or a short SOC-2 addendum note.

> 3) We need a PO-ready line-item breakdown for our ERP import (CSV or XLSX).

Attached: throughput-sla-summary-quantumhealth.xlsx (tabs: line_items_csv, pricing_summary, sla_notes).

Next steps I propose:
- You pick billing cadence (A/B/C) and confirm the ERP recipient email for PO ingestion
- I prepare a DocuSign with the PO amendment and the addendum for signatures

Looping Ben on the thread to confirm pricing approval for the blended rate and to expedite a DocuSign if Procurement chooses option B.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: throughput-sla-summary-quantumhealth.xlsx (XLSX)
From: procurement@quantumhealth.com <procurement@quantumhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 11:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + pool top-up: co-term request & billing schedule options

Marissa / Ben —

Purchasing reviewed the materials and we have two requests before we can issue the PO amendment: 

1) Can Redwood provide a one-paragraph data security attestation stating there is no additional logging or export associated with the added GPUs? We need that for our file.
2) We prefer option B (50% up-front + monthly remainder) but need the invoice split reflected on the PO and in the DocuSign envelope. Also we require the invoice schedule to be: 50% at signature, then monthly invoices on the 1st of each month starting 2027-04-01 for the remaining balance.

If you can send the attestation and updated DocuSign with the invoice schedule I will route for signatures. Our ERP import contact is: erp.ingest@quantumhealth.com.

Regards,
Quantum Health Purchasing
procurement@quantumhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Asha / Purchasing team —

Thanks — attaching the one-paragraph attestation and the updated DocuSign envelope link. Per your request: billing cadence B confirmed. Invoice schedule embedded in the amendment and the DocuSign: 50% at signature (invoice issued same day), remaining balance billed monthly on the 1st starting 2027-04-01. ERP import recipient set to erp.ingest@quantumhealth.com and the attached CSV has the PO-ready lines.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rooms/abc12345 (envelope: Redwood_QH_Addendum_2027)

One-paragraph attestation (also copied into the addendum):
"Redwood Inference confirms that the capacity expansion described in this amendment does not introduce additional telemetry export or KV cache persistence beyond the terms of the existing Master Services Agreement. No additional data egress or third-party export mechanisms are enacted as a result of the added reserved GPUs."

Next steps from our side: I will send the DocuSign envelope now and mark the deal as "Pending Signature" in our pipeline (Deal ID QH-2027-045). Once signed we will issue the 50% invoice and schedule provisioning the expanded reserved pool; provisioning lead time estimated 6–8 business days after payment clears.

Ben — appreciate if you can sign off on the final blended price so we can expedite provisioning post-signature.

Cheers,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
